name: CENNETIC C400 Heavy-Duty Trunnion 5-Axis Machining Center
summary: The C400 is a high-rigidity trunnion 5-axis machining center designed for heavy cutting on tough materials, combining a robust cast bed with direct-drive rotary axes for accurate multi-axis profiling.
body:
The C400 is a high-rigidity trunnion 5-axis machining center designed for heavy cutting on tough materials, combining a robust cast bed with direct-drive rotary axes for accurate multi-axis profiling.

About this model

This 5-Axis Machining Center is manufactured by our partner factory in Dongguan, China, and supplied direct by CENNETIC with factory-direct pricing, a standard warranty and remote setup support. Specifications are representative and can be confirmed against your machining requirements before order.
